title: The rotation curves shapes of late-type dwarf galaxies
findings: The reduction model cubes use a constant Gaussian dispersion of 8 km/s.
The pressure relation is v_c^2 = v_phi^2 - sigma^2 [d ln rho/d ln R + d ln sigma^2/d ln R]. Constant height and dispersion give the slope illustration used in the parent note.

UGC 7577 is among the exceptions with maximum asymmetric-drift correction above 3 km/s. The authors did not apply these corrections. These sections give no actual correction magnitude at the frozen 0.94 kpc bin.
scope: Targeted primary-source verification only. No new kinematic data, fitted pressure correction or HI-profile transfer.
